index.title: Nodex — On the same page as your coding agents
index.description: Shape tasks in Pages, send the right context to coding agents, and keep it beside the code, terminal, and review in one local-first workspace.

download.title: Download - Nodex
download.description: Download Nodex for macOS or install it with Homebrew.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy - Nodex
privacyPolicy.description: Privacy notes for the Nodex public site.

description: Shape tasks in Pages, send the right context to a coding agent,
and keep it beside the code, terminal, and review.

features.description: The Page, agent chat, files, terminal, browser, and Review live in one Project, so the brief remains in reach while the work moves forward.

workspaces.title: Shape
workspaces.description: Draft the task as a Page, structure it in blocks, and select the context that matters.

compactMode.title: Run
compactMode.description: Send that context to a new or existing chat, then work with the agent in the same Project.

glance.title: Review
glance.description: Inspect files and diffs beside the brief without changing apps.

splitView.title: Shared Pages
splitView.description: Agents can search, read, create, and update Pages directly, so useful context can live beyond a chat transcript.

coreValues.title: Our Core Values
coreValues.description: Working context should be tangible, your data should stay local, and the tools around it should remain open.
coreValues.imageAlt: Nodex keeping a Page beside coding-agent work and Review

footer.title: Nodex
footer.description: Open source, local-first software for shared context and agent work.
